repo Grants full access to public and private repositories including read and write access to code, commit statuses, repository invitations, collaborators, deployment statuses, and repository webhooks.
user Grants read/write access to profile info only.
read:org Read-only access to organization membership, organization projects, and team membership.
gist Grants write access to gists.
workflow Grants the ability to add and update GitHub Actions workflow files.

blockers.summary: Organizations with OAuth app access restrictions block members from authorizing the app until an owner approves it

avoidProducts.name: GitHub Actions marketplace publishing
avoidProducts.why: Publishing actions is a different Marketplace program from authorizing an OAuth app

avoidProducts.name: GitHub Apps (registering and installing)
avoidProducts.why: GitHub Apps use fine-grained permissions and installation tokens, not OAuth scopes; scope claims must not be sourced from these pages
avoidProducts.evidence: Differences page states GitHub Apps use fine-grained permissions, OAuth apps use scopes

notes: GitHub also offers GitHub Apps, which GitHub prefers. The golden set follows the OAuth app path because the guide is about OAuth.
The marketplace listing review wait is not documented, so the wait is none for OAuth use only.
